results.name: baseline
results.title: Baseline readiness
results.action: Applies the bridge mode on both MLAG peers, waits for MLAG and LACP to settle, checks MLAG, LACP and the virtual links, and sends numbered pings for 4 s without a fault.

phases.name: Steady state
phases.expected: Both MLAG peers show mlag-state connected, one as MLAG primary and one as MLAG secondary, and use the primary's system ID as the shared system ID. Each client bonds both members and every probe arrives once.

results.name: primary-reboot
results.title: MLAG primary reboot
results.action: Resets the bridge on CHR 1 and CHR 2 over management SSH with the bridge mode of the run, picks the MLAG peer that reports mlag-state connected as primary, and after a loss-free baseline reboots it with `/system reboot` (1 s delay). The runner waits for the guest uptime to reset, then keeps probing for 16 s plus a 3 s recovery window.

phases.name: Primary down
phases.expected: The MLAG secondary reverts its MLAG bonds to its own LACP system ID (mlag-lacp-fallback=yes) and both traffic hosts renegotiate LACP, with brief loss. The virtual links keep carrier, so each host drops its member to the primary only at the LACP short timeout (3 × 1 s). The secondary's edge MLAG bonds keep forwarding throughout.

phases.name: Primary back
phases.expected: The rebooted peer keeps its bond members out of the bond until the MLAG system ID syncs (mlag-init-delay), rejoins as MLAG primary and restores the shared system ID. Both traffic hosts renegotiate LACP to the shared system ID, with brief loss.
